cases.prompt: Review one broad but reversible spec and one narrow spec with irreversible data impact and unclear recovery ownership.
expected: broad reversible may remain medium
narrow dangerous uncertain spec is high
forbidden: classify from file count or spec mode

cases.prompt: A review can repair the spec either by deleting an unnecessary mechanism or by adding flags, telemetry, and fallback infrastructure.
expected: prefer the smallest scope-preserving repair

cases.prompt: An approved spec receives a substantive execution change after review.
expected: invalidate approval for the changed revision
review only invalidated coverage

cases.prompt: A spec proposes a second public access endpoint and new client loader although the existing versioned endpoint can accept optional fields without breaking callers.
expected: report excess scope
prefer a narrow extension of the existing endpoint and loader
forbidden: approve the duplicate seam because its contract is detailed
add compatibility machinery for the duplicate endpoint

cases.prompt: Repository evidence proves the target screen already displays the current plan and remaining time, but the spec lists both as new implementation work.
expected: reclassify existing behavior as preserve plus regression proof
limit implementation to the actual remaining delta

cases.prompt: The source requires configurable lookback and cooldown periods but supplies no values; the spec invents defaults and builds configuration, validation, and analytics around them.
expected: treat material values as an authority gap
block before expanding the technical contract
forbidden: reward extra implementation detail as determinism

cases.prompt: A consolidated repair changes only wording and one existing validation command while preserving scope, owners, public contracts, and mandatory-lens coverage.
expected: use coordinator verification for ordinary findings
reuse valid Full coverage
forbidden: launch a fresh Full because the revision changed

cases.prompt: Raw authority replaces a per-item provider mechanism with aggregate reporting, but the revised spec calls it only privacy-preserving processing and keeps per-item timestamp proof.
expected: recover the concrete authority change
reject the incompatible proof cardinality
require a fresh Full
forbidden: approve a per-item proof for an aggregate claim

cases.prompt: Two platforms share one product goal but use different mechanisms, sources of truth, reporting delays, and redaction rules; the spec gives them one identical exit gate.
expected: split the variant proof contracts unless equivalence is evidenced
test whether each source can observe its exact claim
forbidden: approve symmetry from the shared product goal

cases.prompt: During Closure a repair changes the source of truth and proof from individual records to an aggregate report while leaving the implementation owner unchanged.
expected: invalidate affected coverage
start a fresh Full for the semantic change
forbidden: treat unchanged code ownership as sufficient

cases.prompt: Full review finds aggregate proof for an unchanged per-item claim; the repair substitutes an existing compatible per-item proof without changing authority, claim, owner, or source of truth.
expected: reuse valid Full coverage
verify the affected proof through coordinator verification or normal Closure triggers
forbidden: start a fresh Full for the proof correction
